extracted.intended_audience: researchers applying for Damon Runyon awards and members of award selection committees (cancer research community)
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational standards and expectations for Damon Runyon award selection committees, including committee composition, review responsibilities, and commitments around excellence and equity. Applies to how applications are reviewed, scored, and how recipients are chosen and approved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Uncompromising commitment to excellence
rubrics_metrics.description: The Damon Runyon Cancer Research Foundation has an uncompromising commitment to excellence and values this standard across its Award Programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Committees are expected to uphold very high standards in evaluating applications; excellence is a primary organizing value for selection decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Foundation 'values diversity, equity, and inclusion in all of its Award Programs' and 'seeks to promote gender equality and increase diversity, in all of its forms, throughout our programs.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers should incorporate DEI awareness into their evaluation mindset and the Foundation explicitly frames diversity as an objective of its programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awareness and mitigation of unconscious bias in review
rubrics_metrics.description: Acknowledges that 'often subtle and unconscious biases can dramatically affect outcomes in review processes' and that 'by simply acknowledging that unconscious biases exist, we can combat their potential negative impact.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: At the start of each review session this statement is read aloud; reviewers are instructed to be aware of potential unconscious biases 'when reviewing, scoring and discussing candidates and applications throughout the review process.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Committee composition: leaders and world-renowned scientists
rubrics_metrics.description: Each committee is composed of world-renowned scientists who are leaders in their fields of research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection committees are populated by prominent experts to ensure authoritative, expert evaluation of applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thorough review process and Board approval of recipients
rubrics_metrics.description: Committees 'review all applications and select award recipients, who are then approved by the Damon Runyon Board of Directors.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All submissions receive committee review; final award selections are subject to Board approval, indicating a two-step selection/oversight process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program-specific award committees
rubrics_metrics.description: Separate standing committees exist for each award/program (e.g., Fellowship Award Committee; Clinical Investigator Award Committee; Physician-Scientist Training Award Committee; Damon Runyon-Rachleff Innovation Award Committee; Quantitative Biology Fellowship Award Committee; Damon Runyon-St. Jude Pediatric Cancer Research Fellowship Award Committee; Damon Runyon Scholars Program for Advancing Research and Knowledge).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications are reviewed by the committee specific to the program, implying evaluation criteria and expertise are tailored to each award type.
